### Nextpower to Announce First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results on July 30, 2026


July 9, 2026


FREMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Nextpower](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nextpower.com%2F&esheet=54567948&newsitemid=20260709800754&lan=en-US&anchor=Nextpower&index=1&md5=7422d60a357eef5a89401cedfd8975f7) (Nasdaq: NXT) will announce its first quarter fiscal 2027 financial results after the market closes on Thursday, July 30, 2026. The company will hold a conference call to discuss the results on the same day at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time (5:00 p.m. Eastern Time).


**Q1 FY2027 Earnings Call** July 30, 2026
2:00 p.m. PT / 5:00 p.m. ET
Live webcast available on[investors.nextpower.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.nextpower.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54567948&newsitemid=20260709800754&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.nextpower.com&index=2&md5=70227171854114b7c183d73ba086326c)


The webcast replay, along with supporting materials, will be available on the Nextpower IR website following the conclusion of the event.


**About Nextpower**


Nextpower™ (Nasdaq: NXT) designs, engineers, and delivers an advanced energy technology platform for solar power plants, innovating across structural, electrical, and digital domains. Its integrated solutions streamline project execution, increase energy yield and long-term reliability, and enhance customer ROI. Building on over a decade of technology and market leadership, Nextpower partners with leading energy companies worldwide to meet rapidly expanding global electricity demand. Learn more at[www.nextpower.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nextpower.com&esheet=54567948&newsitemid=20260709800754&lan=en-US&anchor=www.nextpower.com&index=3&md5=dc2cc2ef5866fab0d64de5432d2412c6) .
